description.value: Skyhawk Restaurant serves western and asian cuisines in Delta and offers both dine-in and takeout service. Located on Alpha Way, it serves as a dining stop for cycling tourists passing through the area. With two cuisine styles represented, the menu caters to varied tastes.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 19m; rack at 20m.
